title: Smoked Mozzarella and Sun-Dried Tomato Pizza
changes_from_base: The base is brushed with sun-dried tomato oil and part-baked, then sun-dried tomatoes in a pinwheel and slices of smoked mozzarella replace the tomato sauce and fresh mozzarella.
summary: Par-baked base crowned with a striking spiral of sun-dried tomatoes and soft smoked mozzarella, finished with optional fresh basil.

ingredients.item: pizza dough, shop-bought or homemade, at room temperature
sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained (oil kept)
oil from the sun-dried tomato jar
smoked mozzarella, halved and thinly sliced

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: On a floured surface, roll or stretch the 450 g dough into a 30 cm circle or rectangle that fits your tray, then lift it onto the lightly floured baking tray.

steps.title: Part-bake
steps.text: Brush the top of the dough with oil from the jar of sun-dried tomatoes (about 1½ tbsp) and bake for 15 minutes to firm the base.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Remove from the oven, arrange the 225 g sun-dried tomatoes in a decorative pinwheel pattern, then fit thin slices of the 225 g smoked mozzarella between them.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Bake for a further 5 minutes until the cheese melts and the crust takes on a golden hue.

steps.title: Garnish
steps.text: If you have fresh basil, tear 2 tbsp over the surface and slice to serve.

tips: Pre-bake the base briefly so it holds its shape and doesn't become soggy from the tomato oil
Pat the sun-dried tomatoes with kitchen paper if they are very oily so the base stays crisp.
Watch the cheese carefully in the final minutes as it can brown quickly once it starts to melt
storage: Keep leftovers chilled and consume within 2 days. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
